primitives.name: Per-Website Cloudflare Worker
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Website flow — `type: "website"` (independent brand, phased pipeline) You are building ONE per-website Cloudflare Worker: a **React 19 + TanStack Start** app that is **server-rendered (SSR)** and deploys as a single Worker served at the website's own subdomain.
primitives.assumptions: Each website operates independently with unique deployment and runtime context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Higgsfield or auth is required, pipeline switches to app-type.

layer2.mapping: The worker represents a functional isomorphism between user intent and server-rendered UI state, with Higgsfield as the asset engine.
layer2.telemetry: Build success rate, SSR render time, subdomain availability.

primitives.name: Higgsfield Asset Generation Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Higgsfield as the asset engine — EVERY build.** All visual assets on every website are generated with the Higgsfield CLI generation commands per `references/asset-system.md`.
primitives.assumptions: All visual assets are generated programmatically and consistently.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Asset generation fails if CLI commands are misconfigured or missing.

layer2.mapping: Generates visual identity kits and scene assets from abstract prompts using latent space transformations.
layer2.telemetry: Asset generation latency, fidelity metrics, error count.

primitives.name: Phased Build Pipeline
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## THE PIPELINE — phases in order, artifacts + gates, no skipping Every NEW build runs this machine.
primitives.assumptions: Pipeline stages are ordered and interdependent with fixed artifact dependencies.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Skipping or reordering phases results in invalid builds.

layer2.mapping: Represents a deterministic state-machine with phase transitions governed by artifact readiness.
layer2.telemetry: Phase completion times, artifact validation status, gate compliance.
